# Minnie Park — Creative Studio M.

> Commissioned interactive media art, audio-reactive event visuals and artist-led TouchDesigner workshops by Minnie Park. Based in Seoul and Melbourne, working internationally.

This is the commercial enquiry site. Minnie Park’s ongoing artistic practice, Meta Rose projects, research, exhibition history and CV are documented at the separate artist portfolio. The same artist works across both sites; enquiries do not establish a client relationship or a completed commission.

- [행사·런웨이 비주얼 제작](https://work.minniepark.art/event-visuals/)
